title: Five-Year Local Option Tax for Fire & Ambulance Operations
ballot_label: Caption: Five-Year Local Option Tax for Fire & Ambulance Operations. Question: Shall the District create a new five-year levy of $1.70 per $1000 of assessed value for five years beginning 2027-2028? This measure creates new local option taxes which may cause property taxes to increase more than three percent.
summary: Burlington Water District, which buys fire and ambulance service from Portland Fire & Rescue by contract, proposes a five-year local option levy of $1.70 per $1,000 of assessed value beginning 2027-28. Revenue would pay the district's emergency services costs and maintain a contingency fund. The district says the levy does not affect water service or water rates.
yes_means: A yes vote approves a new five-year Burlington Water District levy of $1.70 per $1,000 of assessed value beginning in 2027-2028.
no_means: A no vote rejects the proposed five-year levy.
fiscal_impact: Estimated about $84,420 in 2027-28 rising to about $95,016 in 2031-32 (average about $87,029 a year), on top of the district's $3.4269 permanent rate. For an average property assessed at $166,000, monthly emergency services cost would rise from $47 to $71 (about $24 more per month).
